english: The assistant who served her did not like the way she was dressed.
text: the way she was dressed 是把她的整身打扮作为评价对象，不是某一件衣服。想说不喜欢一个人的说话或做事方式，也可用 the way someone speaks 或 the way someone does things，把评价落在表现方式上。
